question: Is USDT on Stellar? How does USDT0 get to Stellar, and what kind of asset is it once it is there?

golden.answer: Yes, as USDT0, live on Mainnet as of 2026-11-14. USDT0 is Tether's USDT carried over LayerZero's Omnichain Fungible Token (OFT) standard: USDT is locked on Ethereum and a LayerZero OFT contract on Stellar mints and burns USDT0. On Stellar it is a classic asset with a Stellar Asset Contract, so an account needs a trustline to receive it.
keyFacts: USDT0 is USDT delivered over LayerZero's Omnichain Fungible Token (OFT) standard.
USDT locked on Ethereum backs the USDT0 minted on Stellar.
On Stellar, USDT0 is a classic asset with a Stellar Asset Contract.
An account needs a USDT0 trustline before it can receive USDT0.
avoid: Do NOT say USDT0 moves to Stellar through a custodial bridge.
Do NOT say USDT0 on Stellar is a contract-only token with no classic asset.
golden.notes: Accept the issuer and contract addresses when they match the official pages; do not require them. Accept a later dated status.

The SDF launch page says USDT0 is operated by Everdawn Labs and is a separate asset from USDT, backed 1:1; neither is a key fact. The press release publish date was not extractable, so no launch date is pinned.

sources.quote: USDT is locked in an adapter contract on Ethereum, and the same amount of USDT0 is minted on the destination chain.
On Stellar, USDT0 is a classic asset with a SAC. Classic flows use a trustline plus a payment.
Balances move into and out of Stellar without a custodial bridge or a wrapped representation.
Its supply is unified with USDT on other chains, minted and burned on Stellar by a LayerZero OFT contract. It is live on mainnet only.
USDT0, the infrastructure that brings the most widely used stablecoin Tether (USDT) to every network, is now live on Stellar

corroboration.claim: USDT0 is USDT delivered over LayerZero's OFT standard: USDT is locked on Ethereum and a LayerZero OFT contract on Stellar mints and burns USDT0.

evidence.note: Describes the Ethereum adapter lock and the mint through the Stellar OFT contract.
Stellar's OFT mints the USDT0, whether Ethereum locked the USDT or another chain burned its own.
The operator's own deployment list names the same Stellar OFT contract and asset.

corroboration.claim: On Stellar, USDT0 is a classic asset with a Stellar Asset Contract, live on Mainnet as of 2026-11-14, and a recipient needs a trustline.

evidence.note: States classic asset with a SAC and the trustline requirement.
Mainnet Horizon returns the classic asset record with the documented SAC contract_id and 37,124 authorized trustlines.
Sending USDT0 to an account that has no USDT0 trustline fails with op_no_trust.

corroboration.claim: USDT0 does not reach Stellar through a custodial bridge.

evidence.note: Balances move into and out of Stellar without a custodial bridge or a wrapped representation.
The OFT contract mints through a mint/burn adapter contract that holds the SAC admin role.

evidence: Sibling sweep: q-pc-cross-redstone-sep40 and q-protocol-ledger-close-time mention USDT0 only in passing and do not contradict.
